FAQs

Questions before you order?

Is this a physical book?

No. It is a digital PDF product. No physical item will be shipped.

Will this guarantee that I get selected?

No resource can guarantee selection or a job offer. This kit is intended to help you prepare and practise; results depend on your skills, experience and the employer’s requirements.

Can I use the answers word-for-word?

Use the examples as a starting point. Personalise every answer so it is truthful and reflects your own experience.

What is the ATS Resume Toolkit add-on?

It is an optional ₹99 digital add-on. Use the templates to create a clear, role-relevant resume; no template can guarantee passing every ATS or getting shortlisted.

How will I receive the files?

The delivery method depends on the checkout setup. Before launch, connect your payment confirmation to an automatic download page or an email/WhatsApp delivery workflow.
